goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide serial, ordered-chunk, and paired ordered-chunk F16 projection kernels without claiming cuBLAS, Q8, or route behavior.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with primitive f16 weight loads and explicit ordered-chunk bounds

covered_behavior: matmul_f16_serial_kernel single-thread accumulation over token and output-row grid
matmul_f16_pair_ordered_chunks_kernel paired ordered reduction with independently bounded output rows
excluded_behavior: F16/F32 wrapper environment selection and cuBLAS execution
Q8 conversion or quantized matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

not_claimed_in_this_stage: F16 or F32 cuBLAS dispatch and activation conversion
Q8 conversion or quantized matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal
